title: ComponentDirectoryReceiptState
description: DD-164(4)⑥: CONVERGED: the latest receipt is APPLIED for the version last served to the component; PENDING: a newer version was served within two read intervals; NOT_CONVERGED: the component has not applied what it was served for longer, or stopped reading for more than two intervals; FAILED: the latest receipt is FAILED; NO_RECEIPT: never reported.
